clue.text: Just like Lappish to have another, way of writing "icing on fur"

indicators.note: writing the quoted letters another way means rearranging them into a new order

explanation.surface: A linguist muses that Lapp has its own way of spelling a phrase about frosted fur.
explanation.walkthrough: The quoted phrase looks like a sample of Lappish text, but it is simply the letters to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Lappish (Sami) belongs to the Finno-Ugric language family, along with Finnish and Hungarian, so it is an example of that grouping.

clue.text: Food just mentioned

indicators.note: mentioned means spoken, so the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: just means fair or equitable

explanation.surface: The meal has just been referred to.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Just' pretends to be an adverb meaning recently; it is the adjective fair.

clue.text: United Nations upset over definite possessing of atomic weapons

parts.note: clear means definite or unambiguous

explanation.definitionFit: Nuclear describes arms using atomic fission or fusion, as in a nuclear power meaning a state with the bomb.

clue.text: Scoring allocation follows after men box

clue.text: Place for minority outsiders on Gypsyish encampment closed

clue.text: One printed dashes in bold

explanation.definitionFit: An intrepid person is fearless and daring, a synonym of bold in the sense of courageous.

clue.text: Writer, not an unknown, is impenetrable

explanation.definitionFit: Something impenetrable is solid or tough to break into, a common sense of the adjective meaning firm and unyielding.

clue.text: Pull in a vehicle reversing during motorbike race

clue.text: Well-established key errors excepted for books editor

clue.text: Army engineers wanting vehicle to be green

clue.text: Plant needing unstarted suit to be delivered on time

explanation.definitionFit: The prickly purple-flowered weed, Scotland's emblem, is an example of a plant.

clue.text: Clearing attic, making changes in empty space
